name: io.github.loopcut-ai/loopcut
title: Loopcut
description: Blender cloud tools for agents: GPU renders, free assets, 3D models, character motion, sound, voice.

environmentVariables.name: LOOPCUT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Loopcut API key (lc_...) from loopcut.org/account. Optional: without it, the loopcut_login tool signs in with a browser link.

environmentVariables.name: LOOPCUT_BLENDER
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Blender executable used to pack scenes. Optional: found on PATH and in the usual install folders.
